preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of practice matches N for each test case must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= gi <= 1000000 for gi in goals)
preconditions.description: Each goal count gi must be between 0 and 1000000.

postconditions.description: If the maximum improvement is less than or equal to 0, output 'UNFIT'; otherwise, output the maximum improvement.

postconditions.expression: max_improvement == max(goals[j] - goals[i] for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N) if goals[j] > goals[i])
postconditions.description: The maximum improvement is calculated as the maximum difference between goals scored in later matches and earlier matches.
